subject: Re: EdgeAI Symposium 2026 — Title+ agreement and DocuSign link
messages:
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@edgeai.co>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@edgeai.co
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: EdgeAI Symposium 2026 — sponsorship opportunity

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking a look at EdgeAI Symposium. We reviewed Redwood's interest in a Title+ partner and attached a proposed sponsorship agreement and benefits package (EdgeAI_Symposium_Sponsorship_Agreement_v1.pdf). Highlights include a Title+ position as exclusive sponsor of the AI inference track, one 30-minute keynote OR two 15-minute talks, a 20x20 inline booth in the prime hall, two full-conference passes plus expo badges, homepage logo placement and inclusion in two email blasts.

Total fee: USD 120,000 (net). We can provide a 10% early-execution credit if we receive a signed agreement by May 25.

Let me know if there are non-negotiables and we'll work them into the agreement.

Best,
Sandeep Rao
Head of Partnerships, EdgeAI Events

Attachments: EdgeAI_Symposium_Sponsorship_Agreement_v1.pdf, ExhibitA-floorplan-v3.png

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@edgeai.co>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-11T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeAI Symposium 2026 — sponsorship opportunity

Sandeep,

Thanks — package looks promising. A few clarifications before we send legal a redline:

1) Speaking: we prefer the single 30-minute keynote. Can you confirm it's scheduled in a plenary window (high-attendance) rather than a concurrent breakout?
2) Logo placement: the contract references homepage and main stage backdrop. Can you confirm top-row placement on the backdrop and share the homepage mock where our logo will appear?
3) Recording: do we retain the recording and rights to republish Redwood-branded clips for marketing?
4) Booth AV: confirm power, proximity to demo-stage AV feed, and whether we can request an additional camera input.

Looping in Lauren and Karthik for redlines if these are ok.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

On Sun, May 10, 2026 at 09:12 AM Sandeep Rao <sandeep@edgeai.co> wrote:
> Hi Ben...

From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@edgeai.co>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@edgeai.co
Date: 2026-05-12T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeAI Symposium 2026 — sponsorship opportunity

Ben — answers inline and attached updated materials (we've included Exhibit B homepage mock):

1) Speaking: Confirmed — 30-minute keynote scheduled in Plenary Block A (Day 1, 10:30–11:00), our highest-attendance slot.
2) Logo placement: We will guarantee top-row placement on the stage backdrop (one of up to six logos). Exhibit B contains the homepage mock; developer preview will be provided after artwork approval.
3) Recording/rights: We grant a non-exclusive license to redistribute the recording for marketing, with attribution to EdgeAI Symposium and a restriction on material alteration.
4) Booth/AV: 20x20 inline booth includes standard power and access to demo-stage AV feed; additional camera inputs can be arranged for a fee.

Attached: EdgeAI_Symposium_Sponsorship_Agreement_v1.pdf, ExhibitB-homepage-mockup.png

Best,
Sandeep

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-13T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood redlines for EdgeAI sponsorship (draft)

Team — first-pass redline notes to protect brand and measurement: 

- Lock Day 1 Plenary Block A for Redwood, add clause preventing unilateral rescheduling without prior written consent.
- Expand recording license to perpetual, non-exclusive marketing rights; allow trimming and overlays.
- Require top-row stage backdrop placement and require high-res proof of placement 30 days prior.
- Add lanyard logo placement at a prominent position and require a lanyard artwork proof.
- Lead share: request opt-in attendee list (name, company, title, email) for full-conference and opt-in expo attendees, delivered within 30 days post-event.
- Require post-event metrics for homepage impressions and email blast open/clicks.
- Cancellation: if organizer cancels <30 days out, require 75% refund.

Attaching redline PDF for contracts review.

-Lauren

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@edgeai.co>, contracts@edgeai.co
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-15T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeAI Symposium 2026 — sponsorship contract & speaking slot (redline attached)

Sandeep / contracts team — attached is our redlined agreement (EdgeAI_Symposium_Sponsorship_Agreement_Redline_v2.pdf). Key edits: lock Day 1 Plenary Block A, expand recording rights to perennial marketing use and minor edits, add lead-share with opt-in dataset, specify top-row backdrop and lanyard placement, require post-event metrics, and add 75% refund if cancelled within 30 days. We're ready to sign if you accept these redlines and confirm DocuSign routing.

Ben

From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@edgeai.co>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@edgeai.co, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeAI Symposium 2026 — sponsorship contract & speaking slot

Ben / Lauren — thanks for the thorough redline. Contracts accepted most edits; a few differences to note: 

- Recording: we'll accept perpetual, non-exclusive marketing rights with permission to trim/highlight; we will request attribution in captions ("Recorded at EdgeAI Symposium 2026").
- Lead-share: we will provide opt-in attendee lists but cannot include emails for expo-only badges unless attendees expressly opted in. We can deliver the opt-in dataset within 14 days post-event (earlier than your 30-day ask).
- Lanyard: we can guarantee lanyard logo but not top-of-lanyard placement; we will guarantee top-half positioning in the lanyard artwork.

Final DocuSign packet is live here: https://docusign.edgeai.co/r/ABC123def. Signers should route to legal; once executed we'll apply the 10% early-execution credit.

If everything looks good we'll expect signed packet before May 25 to secure the credit.

Best,
Sandeep Rao
Head of Partnerships, EdgeAI Events
